data.one_liner: HTML rich text editor for Android, iOS, and Web using Summernote
data.what_it_does: Provides a WYSIWYG HTML rich text editor widget for Android, iOS, and Web platforms. It wraps the Summernote JavaScript library with customizable widget-based controls, callbacks, and dark mode support.
use_when: You need a WYSIWYG HTML text editor in your Flutter application across mobile and web platforms.
You want to integrate Summernote-based rich text editing with custom controllers and callbacks.
avoid_when: You need a fully native text editing experience without web view or JavaScript wrappers.
You require a completely stable API without breaking changes while the package is work-in-progress.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and Web.
Includes customizable controls, theme-based CSS, and JavaScript builders.
Maintained with updates for recent Flutter versions.
weaknesses: API is a work in progress with frequent breaking changes.
Web platform experiences flickering and repainting issues when UI elements draw over iframes, requiring the HTML web renderer workaround.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform configuration such as setting minimum SDK versions on Android, INTERNET permission in AndroidManifest.xml, and additional iOS setup for file picking.
